issues.detail: Text element contains raw emoji codepoint U+2705 (allowed as an icon fallback; the visual missing_glyph_box check is the hard gate if it fails to render).
issues.suggested_fix: Prefer an image element pointing to .claude/agents/excalidraw/icons/success_icon.png for text element id: t_emoji (an icon exists for U+2705); keep the raw emoji only if no icon matches and the user did not opt out of emojis.
